items.prompt: A white carnival mask turned around on a dark table so that its hollow inside faces the camera, lit from one side. Although it is concave, it reads unmistakably as a convex face pushing out of the shadow. Nothing else in the frame.

alt.ru: Белая карнавальная маска повёрнута к нам изнанкой, но выглядит выпуклым лицом, выступающим из тени.
alt.en: A white carnival mask turned inside-out toward us, yet it reads as a convex face emerging from shadow.
alt.pt: Uma máscara de carnaval branca virada do avesso para nós, mas parece um rosto convexo a sair da sombra.
alt.es: Una máscara de carnaval blanca vuelta del revés hacia nosotros, que aun así parece un rostro convexo saliendo de la sombra.

items.prompt: A completely empty small room in near darkness, a single wooden chair in the middle, a thin line of light under a closed door. Utterly still, nothing to see, nothing happening.

alt.ru: Пустая тёмная комната: посередине один деревянный стул, под закрытой дверью тонкая полоска света.
alt.en: An empty dark room: a single wooden chair in the middle, a thin line of light under a closed door.
alt.pt: Um quarto vazio e escuro: uma única cadeira de madeira ao centro, uma linha fina de luz sob a porta fechada.
alt.es: Una habitación vacía y oscura: una sola silla de madera en el centro, una fina línea de luz bajo la puerta cerrada.
